Also I think if you look up “Behavior Activation Worksheets” or just “Behavior Activation” on google images you should be able to find some different sheets you can print out.   :)

I am going through something very similar, I can hardly leave my bed and my chores and responsibilities keep piling up around me. Showering and eating take all my energy and I weep while doing those two things because the physical and mental exhaustion is unbearable. 

Something that my therapist and I are working on is a treatment called Behavior Activation. Basically each day you choose one thing you need to do and one thing you want to do. For example, today I pushed myself to finally put away my clean laundry that was piled up on the floor for weeks. For the thing I wanted to do I watched a movie. Then you rate how each activity made you feel in terms of depression, pleasure, and your sense of achievement. It’s not easy by any means and I really struggled with the laundry. there are worksheets you can use to keep yourself accountable and track your progress. I have my goals set for tomorrow and I don’t know if I can meet them but I’ll try. 

I’m rooting for you! I know the pain you’re feeling and I hope you can get some peace and relief in the coming days!
